ChargebackBot: ALERT: Cardholder dispute received for charge id ch_77091. Reason: fraudulent_transaction. Amount: $12,450.00. Customer: OrionHealth AI (acct: orion-004). Dispute ref: dsp_4410.

Elena: High-value dispute, tagging Legal. Marcus, please pull contract and PO. Did finance receive a signed PO for this amount?

Marcus: We have a PO (PO-8899) for $12,450 approved by procurement on 2026-03-10. Contract shows seat counts and deliverables. Uploading to dsp_4410.

FinanceOps: Payment was settled via card ending 1234 on 2026-03-15. Charge appears genuine from our logs, but cardholder says fraud. Need evidence of IPs, user agent, session IDs, and SSO confirmation.

LegalBot: Please prepare a timeline and include the signed PO, contract, SSO logs indicating user login from corporate domain (orionhealth.com), recent support interactions confirming user authorization, and internal AM email approvals.

Elena: Also check for any previous chargebacks from same account or same card. If repeated pattern, escalate to Risk for possible account termination.

Marcus: Quick check: no prior disputes from orion-004. Card ending 1234 used only once in our history.

FinanceOps: Evidence list: (1) PO-8899 PDF, (2) signed contract SVC-2109, (3) invoice INV-2026-304, (4) SSO assertion tokens showing corporate email accepted at time of purchase, (5) API delivery logs with timestamps, (6) AM approval email thread.

Elena: Requesting the AM to confirm identity of purchaser and whether procurement normally authorizes via PO. If AM confirms, we'll submit rebuttal. If not, prepare to refund and freeze account.

Marcus: AM replied: "Procurement confirmed and PO matched contract. Payment authorized by finance@orionhealth.com." Adding to dsp_4410.

LegalBot: Based on provided evidence, we can file a rebuttal. Prepare a redacted packet for the card network including PO, contract, login IPs, and delivery proof. Note: redact any HIPAA-sensitive logs per compliance.

Elena: We'll submit rebuttal within 7 days. Marking dsp_4410 as priority P0. FinanceOps will not provision capacity changes until resolved.

FinanceOps: Submitting now to processor (submission_ref: sub_9988). Will update once we get confirmation from the network.

Elena: Good work. Keep Legal looped for any follow-on.

ChargebackBot: PROCESS UPDATE: submission sub_9988 received by FastGate. Estimated response window: 45-75 days.
